title: Relative Hochster--Takayama formula and Cohen--Macaulay monomial ideal quotients
summary: Hochster's and Takayama's formulas describes the multigraded components of local cohomology modules of monomial ideals in terms of simplicial complexes. In this paper, we develop a relative version of these formulas for quotients $I/J$ of monomial ideals, expressing the multigraded pieces of local cohomology modules of $I/J$ as reduced relative (co)homology of pairs of degree complexes. As an application, we obtain a relative Reisner criterion characterizing Cohen-Macaulay monomial ideal quotients.
